name: Benchhub-Indo
description: Benchhub-Indo is a benchmark suite for evaluating Indonesian language models across a range of NLP tasks, aggregating multiple datasets and task formats. It measures model capabilities on classification, QA, NER and generation tasks in Indonesian to provide a unified comparison of Indo-centric models.
reputation: Moderately adopted within the Indonesian NLP community as a useful multi-task suite for benchmarking Indo-centric models, though not yet a global standard.
